reason: I'm on the road twice a month and sleep badly in hotels, so a pre-counted sachet I can toss in my bag is exactly my problem. $24.99 for the first box is low enough to try on impulse, and the empty-box refund takes most of the risk away.
objection: Will I actually feel a difference? I've bought magnesium before and felt nothing, and I can't tell if this one is any different from a cheap bottle.
